#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

const int MOD = 1'000'000'007;

ll modpow(ll b, ll e) {
    ll ans = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) ans = (ans * b) % MOD;
        b = (b * b) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

class disjoint_set {
public:
    vector<int> parent, rnk;
    int comps;

    disjoint_set(int n) : parent(n), rnk(n, 0), comps(n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) parent[i] = i;
    }

    int find(int u) {
        if (parent[u] != u) parent[u] = find(parent[u]);
        return parent[u];
    }

    void merge(int u, int v) {
        u = find(u);
        v = find(v);
        if (u == v) return;
        if (rnk[u] < rnk[v]) swap(u, v);
        parent[u] = v;
        if (rnk[u] == rnk[v]) ++rnk[v];
        --comps;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    vector<bool> seen(p, false);
    disjoint_set dsu(p);

    for (ll i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        for (ll j = i; !seen[j]; j = (j * k) % p) {
            seen[j] = true;
            dsu.merge(i, j);
        }
    }

    int c = dsu.comps;
    if (k != 1) --c;

    cout << modpow(p, c) << '\n';

    return 0;
}

struct UnionFind {

    int numComponents;
    
    explicit UnionFind(int size) : parent(size), height(size, 0), numComponents(size) {
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) parent[i] = i;
    }
    
    int find(int node) {

        if (height[a] > height[b]) {

        }

        if (height[a] == height[b]) ++height[b];
        --numComponents;
    }

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using lint = long long;

const lint MOD = 1000000007;

lint fast_pow(lint base, lint exp) {
    lint res = 1;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

struct DisjointSet {
    vector<int> root;
    vector<int> depth;
    int component_count;

    DisjointSet(int n) : root(n), depth(n), component_count(n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) root[i] = i;
    }

    int find(int x) {
        if (root[x] != x) root[x] = find(root[x]);
        return root[x];
    }

    void connect(int x, int y) {
        x = find(x), y = find(y);
        if (x == y) return;
        if (depth[x] > depth[y]) swap(x, y);
        root[x] = y;
        if (depth[x] == depth[y]) depth[y]++;
        component_count--;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    lint p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    vector<int> visited(p);
    DisjointSet dsu(p);

    for (lint i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        for (lint j = i; !visited[j]; j = (j * k) % p) {
            visited[j] = 1;
            dsu.connect(i, j);
        }
    }

    int result_components = dsu.component_count;
    if (k != 1) result_components--;

    cout << fast_pow(p, result_components) << '\n';

    return 0;
}
